name: Operations History at Scale
summary: Keep instance replay intelligible and responsive with grouped multi-instance execution, bounded iteration discovery and exact causal drill-down at 50,000 iterations.
next_action: Merge the OHS2 index-v2 and bounded-API PR (loopCounter, state and incident indexes, signed cursor, 50k acceptance); then the Operations Multi-Instance Explorer and a bounded instance overview that no longer loads the full timeline; then the verified legacy-store rebuild and OHS3 detail replay. Engine quadratic MI-subprocess completion is Issue #1494.

slices.title: Default grouped multi-instance history
slices.note: PR #1483 merged: grouped history is available in Operations, while legacy timeline loading remains unbounded until OHS2/OHS3.

slices.title: Bounded iteration lookup and filtering
slices.note: #1487 (keys), #1488 (projection) and #1490 (fail-closed readiness) merged. Index schema v2 adds loopCounter order, lifecycle-state and incident families, write-only body counters and nested-body parents; api/mihistory serves the cursor-paged, off-writer, HMAC-cursor API and MCP tools with a 50,000-iteration end-to-end acceptance. Open: Operations Explorer UI, a bounded instance overview, verified rebuild for legacy (pre-v2) stores, and #1494 (quadratic MI-subprocess completion).

slices.title: Scalable iteration detail replay
slices.note: Bounded causal frame and variable/incident/decision drill-down, 50k performance evidence and full replay/retention compatibility.
